limitations: Phase 7 verifies audit, weighting, diagnostic-join and escalation contracts with fixtures; no live reference-bank audit was performed.
No measured accuracy, calibration, false-positive, false-negative or class-confusion result is claimed without human-reviewed production audit rows.
Reference-quality associations prioritize review and never establish that a reference image is misidentified.
An insufficient sample triggers review and cannot become quality approval; a passing software suite is not scientific validation.

tasks.outcome: Defines typed Polars audit and summary schemas, eleven required analysis dimensions, an explicit quality policy and paired machine/human reports.
Computes weighted class metrics and confidence intervals from human-reviewed Flickr labels, preserving unavailable and insufficient-sample states and separating probabilities from raw margins.
Joins selected underperforming species to descriptive reference diagnostics for prioritization while explicitly declining reference-identity conclusions.
Applies a fingerprinted species-level escalation policy and persists each observed value, operator and threshold that triggered targeted reference review.
